description: A funding claim cited to a document about an office lease. The gate ALLOWS this, and the advisory overlap check flags it.
response: Northwind closed a 12 million dollar funding round on 2026-01-20 [1].

sources.title: Northwind opens a new office in Leeds
sources.snippet: Northwind has signed a lease on office space in Leeds, with the move planned for the autumn.

notes: This is the honest limit of the design and it is a fixture rather than a footnote. The gate enforces that a claim is SOURCED. It does not check that the source SUPPORTS the claim, because that needs an entailment model and this repository makes no inference calls. The overlap check is a lexical hint for a human, not a verdict.
